_meta.grader: Claude (AI assistant) in the team's planning chat, at Darren's request. Unreviewed by a person.
_meta.blind: Graded from verification/relevance_to_grade.json, which lists cwe, chunk_id, doc, section and text only: no configuration, rank or score.
calibration: Followed the grades already in relevance_labels.json: on-topic descriptions, symptoms, introductions and examples of the weakness are 2 (e.g. Injection_Prevention#008, Java_Security#014, DOM_based_XSS#001); 'how to test' sections are 1 (Injection_Prevention#009, #010); the topic counts, not the platform (FastAPI#016 is 2).
A split piece takes its parent's grade only when it carries the same kind of content; a piece that on its own carries no guidance is graded on its own text.
